question: By defeating which state’s team had Punjab won the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy at the IS Bindra PCA Stadium in November 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Punjab defeated Gujarat to win the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy in November 2023.
 
• The final match took place at the IS Bindra PCA Stadium, Mohali.
 
• This victory marked Punjab's first win in the history of the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy.
 
• The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy is a domestic T20 cricket championship in India, organized by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• Punjab's cricket team showed remarkable performance throughout the tournament to clinch the title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**

 
 
• Named after the famous Indian cricketer Syed Mushtaq Ali.
 
• It is a premier domestic T20 cricket championship in India.
 
• The tournament is administered by the BCCI and features state teams from across the country.
 
• It serves as a platform for players to showcase their talent and get selected for the Indian Premier League (IPL) and the national team.
 
 
 
• **Punjab Cricket Team**
 
 
• Represents the Indian state of Punjab in domestic cricket competitions.
 
• Home ground is the PCA Stadium in Mohali.
 
• Has produced several notable cricketers who have represented India internationally.
 
• Known for its strong performances in domestic cricket tournaments over the years.
 
 
 
• **IS Bindra PCA Stadium**
 
 
• Located in Mohali, Punjab.
 
• Named after former BCCI president Inderjit Singh Bindra.
 
• It is one of the premier cricket stadiums in India and hosts international matches.
 
• Known for its excellent facilities and infrastructure.
